security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, relative documentation links, HTML terms, and email-client compatibility guidance. The Resend test-send instruction is a confirmed external-command capability with an optional live network action, although its stated scope is limited to user-owned test inboxes.

remediation.issue: The render-test workflow includes a Python command that can send live email through Resend.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before using --live, validate all command arguments, and restrict recipients to addresses the user confirms they control.

content.value_statement: Email layouts often break across clients, dark mode, and image-blocked views. This skill builds robust HTML and documents client-specific risks.
actual_capabilities: Builds single-column, table-based email layouts with inline styles.
Plans responsive behavior for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android.
Checks dark-mode contrast, image-off behavior, alt text, and reading order.
Creates bulletproof HTML buttons with Outlook-compatible fallback guidance.
Produces a client-render matrix labeled as Measured or Estimated.
Compares or creates a plain-text alternate that matches the HTML message and links.
limitations: It requires approved copy or existing HTML before building an email.
It does not write marketing copy or calculate email quality scores.
Client results remain Estimated without a real seed or preview test.
Live Resend tests require configured credentials, verified senders, and user-controlled inboxes.

use_cases.title: Build a Campaign Email
use_cases.description: Convert approved campaign content into responsive email HTML with dark-mode and image-off fallbacks.

use_cases.title: Repair Client Rendering
use_cases.description: Review existing HTML and identify layout failures in Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, and mobile clients.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release QA
use_cases.description: Create an accessibility checklist, plain-text parity review, and evidence-labeled client matrix before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Build Basic Email HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: Build responsive email HTML from this approved content: [content]. Use destination [URL] and preserve every word.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a first email build from approved copy.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this email HTML for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android: [HTML]. Report dark-mode and image-off defects.
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess an existing template before release.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Outlook Rendering
prompt_templates.prompt: Repair this email for Outlook desktop while preserving other clients: [HTML]. Add bulletproof buttons and explain each compatibility change.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolve known Outlook layout or button failures.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Evidence-Based QA
prompt_templates.prompt: Build and assess this email: [content or HTML]. Use these render results: [results]. Label every matrix row Measured or Estimated.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine implementation with advanced, evidence-based release QA.

output_examples.input: Build a promotional email from approved copy for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and mobile.
output: A responsive single-column email build with inline styling.
Dark-mode, accessibility, image-off, and plain-text parity results.
A client matrix that marks untested results as Estimated.

output_examples.input: Review an existing newsletter that loses its call-to-action in Outlook.
output_examples.output: A repaired layout with a bulletproof call-to-action, an explanation of the Outlook issue, and updated client-specific QA notes.

output_examples.input: Prepare a release report using seed-test screenshots from three inboxes.
output_examples.output: A render matrix that marks observed clients as Measured, keeps untested clients Estimated, and lists unresolved defects.

best_practices: Provide approved copy, destination links, brand constraints, and target clients before building.
Supply real seed-test or preview evidence when client-level certainty matters.
Confirm recipients and sender details before any live render-test email.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent campaign copy during render implementation.
Do not treat Estimated compatibility results as measured test outcomes.
Do not place essential offers, claims, or calls-to-action only inside images.

faq.question: Does this skill write email copy?
faq.answer: No. It preserves approved copy and focuses on HTML implementation and render QA.

faq.question: Which email clients are covered?
faq.answer: The default set includes Gmail, Outlook desktop and web, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android clients.

faq.question: Can it guarantee identical rendering everywhere?
faq.answer: No. It documents expected compatibility, but real client certainty requires seed or preview testing.

faq.question: Does it support dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks explicit colors, contrast, forced inversion risks, and logo visibility.

faq.question: Can it send a test email?
faq.answer: It can propose a Resend connector command when configured. Live sending requires explicit confirmation and user-controlled test inboxes.

faq.question: What inputs are required?
faq.answer: Provide approved copy or HTML. Include destination links, target clients, brand constraints, and render evidence when available.
